title: War of Wits
text: War of Wits is an annual on-spot strategy based competition for students of IIT Kharagpur organized by The KGPian Game Theory Society. The first edition WOW 1.0 was held on Saturday, 30th March 2013 in association with Consulting Club, Vinod Gupta School of Management. More than 300 students participated in the event. The 2nd edition WOW 2.0 was organized on 3rd April 2015 and witnessed a participation of more than 350 students.

War of Wits

War of Wits is an annual on-spot strategy based competition for students of IIT Kharagpur organized by The KGPian Game Theory Society. The first edition WOW 1.0 was held on Saturday, 30th March 2013 in association with Consulting Club, Vinod Gupta School of Management. More than 300 students participated in the event. The 2nd edition WOW 2.0 was organized on 3rd April 2015 and witnessed a participation of more than 350 students.
